meta.project: The Status-Update Tax - Team Task & Standup Bot
meta.how_to_use: For each case feed 'input' (plus optional 'context') to the bot for the meta digest_date. Compare its digest + tracker writes to 'expected'. 'must_not' items are hard failures. Every blocker must carry source message IDs that resolve through msg_link_template.

categories.faithfulness: TC-001..TC-012 - summaries must say only what was said
categories.blocker_linking: TC-013..TC-022 - every blocker traceable to its source message(s)
categories.tracker_output: TC-023..TC-032 - structured write-back to the task tracker
categories.robustness: TC-043..TC-050 - injection, languages, time zones, empty days

tracker.rule: Done is only reachable from In Review. Skipping a gate must be proposed, never applied.
tracker.unstated_fields_policy: leave null - never infer priority, severity or assignee

test_cases.title: Started-but-nothing-done must not become progress
test_cases.why_hard: Words like 'started' and 'looked at' tempt models to write 'working on / made progress'.

input.text: Started poking at the auth refactor today. Read through the session code, nothing changed yet. Will probably start the actual change tomorrow.

progress: priya_n: began investigating the auth refactor (code reading only); no changes made yet
must_not: states auth refactor is done or in code-change stage

test_cases.title: Past blocker, explicitly resolved
